summary: Frozen the unified Agent-operated OS and ecosystem chain: Linux is the deterministic substrate, Agent Runtime is the OS control plane, agentd remains thin, and aom extends the OS through runtime-mediated artifacts.
acceptance_evidence: agent-operated-os-chain.md defines Agent Runtime as the control layer after agentd PID 1.
agent-operated-os-chain.md states agentd is PID 1 but not the large agent brain and keeps lifecycle/projection/process integration responsibilities.
runtime-ecosystem-architecture.md states aom artifact activation must become PlanSpec and pass through SecurityExecutionEngine.
acceptance-gates.md blocks normal-mode arbitrary shell and activation bypass.
blocked_shortcuts: No ecosystem activation outside AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine.
No agentd-owned resolver or adapter business logic.

verification.command: Select-String docs for AgentCore, SecurityExecutionEngine, aom and shell blockers

promotion_impact: Enables ordered execution of Agent Runtime and ecosystem tasks without changing baseline runtime code.
